description: This file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates the use of AutoCompleteTextView with data fetched from the Contacts content provider. It initializes an AutoCompleteTextView, queries the Contacts database, and sets an adapter to provide auto-complete suggestions based on contact data.

classes.name: AutoComplete5
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a UI with an AutoCompleteTextView populated with contact data from the device's contacts database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, queries contact data, and configures the AutoCompleteTextView with an adapter.
